Name: Lilly's Skitty (Pokemon)
Author: Letsgolilly
Description:
Adds Skitty as a Barn animal.
Skitty will gather soft items for you at night.
These items when consumed will give you a short speed boost to escape danger.
They can also be put in the recycling machine for Doll Stuffing.
Doll stuffing can be used to make Dolls of various Pokémon.
Use Shiny Cloth to make the Dolls in to their Shiny variants.
Use the Doll-Trade Book to trade your regular Dolls for placeable ones.
Skitty can be purchased at Marnie.
If you're lucky you might even buy a shiny one.

You can get extra Dolls if you download my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24376]Tinkaton[/url]﻿﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24418]Ribombee[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30176]Delibird & Iron Bundle[/url]﻿ mod.
